tracks.text: Green, fuzzy parasite eggs resembling viruses float in darkness
Speckles of green light fall from the sky over a vast, urban landscape.
Murano stands between suburban houses, staring left, her back to a camellia bush.
Shinichi stands by powerlines and a crosswalk, staring right, his back to a camellia bush
The two float in a void of shattering glass
Migi's green eye opens.
A web of arteries and neurons pulse red, illuminating text, Parasyte: the maxim
Migi smiles with a toothy mouth in the palm of its hand. A green eye stares from the thumb.
Shinichi steps into water, rippling its reflection of a dark city and red sky. He stares up as buildings, street lights, and power lines float at odd angles.
A crowd crosses and freezes. Flesh monsters covered in eyes and blades erupt from random people.
Ryouko Taniya and a woman with back length hair stand back to back. A flock of butterflies briefly passes, and the women's head grow into a mass of eyes and blades.
Shinichi stands under water, his right hand over his heart.
Amongst the universe, Shinichi stares forward. A boy with short, brown hair stares right.
Mister A, in a suit, stares left
Rows of eyes and teeth and flesh flash. A girl with back length brown hair stares away from us, at a massive, full moon in a cloudy sky.
She looks towards us, opening her brown eyes. In her place, Missus. Izumi stares at us with brown eyes. Lines trace across her face.
In a warm, glowing void, Shinichi embrace Murano, both nude.

Shinichi falls from darkness, passing buildings and lights and metal towers. Faces flash by, depicting a gaunt man, Yuko and a girl, a graying man, blood dripping from teeth, and rows of eyes. Shinichi lands in water under a blue sky. His hair slicked back, he holds out Migi
text, stage 4, tangled hair
Mister A swings out with bladed tendrils. Migi blocks. A blur of bladed flesh swings between Shinichi and Mister A's body.
Blades make contact in a blur of silver, white, and red
Blades contact in front of his face
Shinichi pulls his spear from his waistband and stabs Mister A in the chest.
Mister A's eyes roll around. He swings at Shinichi, Migi blocks, A grabs Migi, and flings them down the hall.
Blood spurts from the spear
He shoves the spear further through his chest.
Mister A stumbles down the hall, his flesh tendrils deflating
Migi looks at Mister A, at the end of a trail of bloody footprints.
The students stand on the field outside
Mister A reforms his face to resemble a human as he stumbles towards a science lab.
Ryouko looks back at him as she jumps out of a window, leaving several canisters on the floor.
The students flinch and look up at the dark smoke rising from the building.
Headline, murderer breaks into high school
Mister Izumi scrolls on his tablet. His wife brings a cup.
Miss Izumi furrows her brow.
In his room, Shinichi lies in bed, staring at his left hand.
Crowds sit and stand on the train. Shinichi rests against a doorway, staring at the overhead ads.
Staff Meeting Room
She exits the staff room, leaving the faculty gaping. Shinichi exits school.
Ryouko stands in front of Shinichi. They stare at each other. Later, they stand together behind the school.
Migi opens an eye and looks at him.
He blanches. Her face darkens, her teeth sharpens. Deep in her pupils, specks of red light float in an endless, black void. They burst in light fading into the image of the Earth in space
Behind the school building, Ryouko and Shinichi stare at each other.
He shakes
She strokes her hair with her right hand. It becomes long blades. The left side of her head slices several times, revealing blades.
Migi fingers morph into blades.
Ryouko stares at Shinichi, his teeth gritted, sweat gathering across his face.
Deep in his pupils, a few motes of red light float in an endless void.
Ryouko un-morphs and walks away
Shinichi looks at Migi, who un-morphs the blades and looks back at him
At night, an older woman rings the doorbell at an apartment.
Ryouko slowly turns back to the mother
Ryouko's eyes widen. A tendril of flesh whips out from her head, around the corner, and strikes the mother.
She walks to the living room. The phone dangles from its cradle. Blood splatter dapples the ground by the woman's feet, and pools under the woman's neck.
Morning, at the Izumi house
Shinichi opens his eyes, sits up, grabs his glasses and puts them on. He slowly blinks and looks down at his right arm, which is missing.
Migi walks around on 4 legs like a small dog, with eyes at the end of its neck and tail. It bounds over to the bed then attaches to Shinichi's arm.
Migi wriggles around under the blankets
Blade fingers
Breakfast table
Miss Izumi lowers her chopsticks and rice
Mister Izumi glances at his wife, who stares at Shinichi. He averts his eyes.
He walks off. His parents stare.
Miss Izumi washes plates, a scar running down her right arm. Mister Izumi glances at it.
Child Shinichi pulls over a stool and climbs up, reaching for the plates above the microwave.
He slips and falls to the ground beneath the stove.
The tempura pot falls towards him Miss Izumi catches the pot with her bare hands, the boiling oil splashing down her hand and arm
She looks at the oil and runs to the sink
Present day, Migi looks at a Sig Sauer P220 and morphs an appendage into the pistol
Mister Izumi reads from his tablet while his wife washes dishes.
Shinichi looks down. Migi opens an eye and looks back at him
He stands and leaves. Nobuko, his mother, dabs her tears. Her husband pats her shoulder and smiles.
Later, bags pile in the entryway
Shinichi opens his mouth, blushes, and looks away
The parents leave. Shinichi slumps off.
At night, Ryouko stands on a rooftop, looking over downtown Fukuyama City. She brings a hand to her stomach and looks down at it.
Scattered white clouds float over a pale, blue sky. Various pictures appear in the style of a children's book.
A pink bicycle sits in front of a house.
A bald man walks a golden retriever.
A mom unlocks a door as her children follower her.
Potted plants line an alley in front of a brick house.
A woman waters dozens of potted plants with a hose
A girl stands in front of a gate with a lunch box
A white door with yellow trim
A rose bush grows around a front gate
6 cats sleep in front of a door
A girl with back length hair runs out of a front door, her mother watching
A traditional gate is covered in snow
A woman with shoulder length hair walks into the entryway of a high rise
An elderly couple pray at a small shrine
A bush is neatly trimmed next to sliding doors
A car sits in a car park next to a pair of doors at a duplex
A subway door opens, and a crowd emerges

A single orange flower grows at the base of a tree. Roots stretch out. The trunk of the tree rises higher and higher, eventually branching out as the trunk narrows, hosting enough leaves to block out the sky.
The front gate at the Izumi house lies open. The front door opens, and Shinichi approaches the foyer, wearing glasses, a gray hoodie, and blue sweat pants. He smiles quizzically.
Red text in the window, Parasyte the maxim
